∀ {k : Type u_1} (A : Type u_2) {X : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Ring.{u_2} A]
  [inst_2 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} X] [inst_3 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k X] [inst_4 : Module.{u_2, u_3} A X] {ι : Type u_4}
  [inst_5 : Fintype.{u_4} ι] (b : Module.Basis.{u_4, u_1, u_3} ι k X)
  (f : LinearMap.{u_2, u_2, max u_2 u_4, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A) (ι → A) X),
  (∀ (a : ι → A),
      Eq.{u_3 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), max (u_2 + 1) (u_4 + 1), u_3 + 1} f a)
        (Finset.sum.{u_4, u_3} Finset.univ.{u_4} fun i =>
          HSMul.hSMul.{u_2, u_3, u_3} (a i)
            (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1), u_4 + 1, u_3 + 1} b i))) →
    Eq.{max (max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)) (u_4 + 1)} f (Etingof.freeCover.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} A b)
